horoscope: Today's energies are quite imperfect for major decision-making, dear Aries, as essential details or nuances are likely to be missed or ignored. Love may be confusing. You may be on the fence about a matter, or you might only feel a little drained and divided in your focus. Watch for body language or omissions that give off impressions you don't want to make. Unusually, both Venus and Mercury turn direct today after retrograde cycles. There is such a thing as too much information, and today, it might lead to errors if we push decision-making. Over the coming days and weeks, you're likely to come to a more definite sense of what you want to do and where you want to go, particularly in an intimate relationship or concerning finances. A complicated matter may begin to smooth over. You’ll see changes and forward movement in your relationships, projects, and money/resources. Some of the discoveries you’ve made about your relationship needs and values are likely to impact decisions, helping round them out. Certain plans you've made recently may now seem less important or not even necessary. Today, avoid jumping to conclusions and jumping into action, as you may not be in touch with your intuition, temporarily focusing too heavily on superficial information.

In an unusual turn of events, both Mercury and Venus end their retrograde cycles today, dear Taurus. Over the coming days and weeks, you'll gain more clarity in certain areas of your life, particularly regarding relationships, work, health, and routines. Money or ownership matters may also clarify. Be patient as recent problems begin to smooth over in the coming days. Communicating with partners and getting a clear understanding of where a partner stands should be more comfortable going forward, slowly but surely. Misunderstandings are still possible today, so take things slowly. Venus is your ruling planet, and with it now ending its six-week retrograde cycle, you’ll be gearing up to make changes. You’ve felt dissatisfaction or imbalance in your job, daily environment, or close relationships more acutely, and now you see where you can improve. In the weeks ahead, you’ll enjoy opportunities to bring more harmony to your everyday life. Confidence in yourself, your work, and your relationships builds now. Gradually, you’ll enjoy lighter and more straightforward interactions. Love and pleasure flow more naturally. People around you are more diplomatic and courteous, which is something you particularly enjoy. Satisfaction in your job may increase. Today, take things easy and avoid make-or-break decisions and commitments.

You can be especially focused on harmony in your romantic life or on getting in touch with your creative muse as you advance, dear Gemini, and with Venus ending its six-week retrograde cycle today, you’ll feel more confident and competent in so doing. This is a good time for looking at your creative and romantic life, as well as your hobbies and pleasures, differently, leading to lovely insights. Questioning current attachments is possible now, and it can be a useful process, either serving to strengthen your commitments or alerting you to stale areas of your life that can use your attention. Certain delays and uncertainties are lifting now. There should also be some forward movement in your relationships, work, and health matters. You might enjoy some second chances or have an opportunity to redo things that recently caused you trouble, this time around with more wisdom. With your planetary ruler, Mercury, also ending its retrograde today, you'll find some plans or projects that have stalled begin to move forward over the coming week. While you should still be a little more careful in your communications today, and you should keep an extra eye on details that could be missed, more clarity is on its way regarding work and health in particular. Not all information is available to you at the moment, but some of the excess "traffic" is clearing now, and it feels good. Still, consider that we're in a transition period for today, and save your energy and decisions for later.

Both Mercury and Venus turn direct after weeks of retrograde motion today, dear Cancer. While today and tomorrow can be a little chaotic, this shift in direction can eventually bring improved communication, more comfort in your domestic world, and more clarity in your romantic or creative life. Indecision tends to clear up, and disjointed ideas and projects come together. With the shifts occurring today, some confusion remains. It's best not to focus superficially on what is or isn't said; instead, be patient as problems begin to resolve. Choose not to react too quickly to communications. As you advance, there can be less concern about the past and more inclination to live in the present when pursuing your passions. You may be focusing on bringing harmony, balance, and peace to your home life and family dynamics with greater success. Problems may resurface, but you are looking at them in new ways, and you’ll have a clearer idea of what matters most to you. You appreciate that people seem kinder and that your own feelings are clearer.

Mercury comes to the end of its retrograde today, dear Leo, and so does Venus! These direct turns can point to clearer, improved communication with family and easier, more flowing connections in the coming days and weeks. While you're unlikely to see immediate results today, and misunderstandings can be pronounced now with these planets stationing, you can look forward to more clarity soon. There will be less focus on the past and more forward-looking energy in your life. Plans that stalled or were on hold may move forward. Recent ideas and revelations might start to come together, while you may have rethought the viability of others. You can be quite focused on bringing more harmony to your communications, daily life, and friendships. The insights you’ve gained about the past, mainly related to your relationships and projects, are helpful for making decisions, changes, and improvements in the weeks ahead. Today, lay low and take things easy. Don’t push yourself to make decisions, and keep in mind that no one truly sees things clearly just yet.

Mercury ends its retrograde today, dear Virgo, and so does Venus. While it's a sign that some things will move forward, it's best to be especially sensitive when choosing the words to express yourself today. Many recent misunderstandings are likely to clear up in the coming weeks, but any transition or station tends to magnify problem areas. It's important to avoid focusing on the superficial elements of conversations or the trivial side of matters. Conserve energy now. Over the coming weeks, you may return to previous discussions, projects, and interests that were confusing or stalled, now with new information and more decisiveness. Ideally, you have a better understanding of your financial situation and of what you truly want and need. You might find missing objects, money, or areas of weakness in a budget. You’re ready to explore your options. In the weeks ahead, you’ll begin to see delays lifting and new perspectives or second chances. Financial problems, delayed income or projects, and confusion over property can clear themselves up in the coming days and weeks. It’s also a time to gain more clarity in long-distance relationships, with siblings and classmates, and in your career. Take your time for best results, and aim to avoid situations that require judgments of value today if this is possible.

Unusually, both your ruling planet, Venus, and Mercury end their retrograde cycles today, dear Libra. Energy is stop-and-go for now, but you’re likely to feel clearer, more confident, and above it all. Technical problems are easier to take when you know what’s in your heart. There can be some nice opportunities to enjoy new interests or take a fresh look at old problems. This can be a time for editing a project, picking up a skill that you may have dropped in the past, reconnecting with old classmates or acquaintances, or talking about past relationships. Ideally, you’re looking at yourself, your personal goals, and your image in a different light, helping you to make more informed decisions in the weeks ahead. You may feel that you’re given second chances or picking up the pieces. Relationships, as well as who/what you’re attracting into your life, can change gears now. Until the disorientation of these directional shifts subside, it’s best not to make or break commitments. Take your time! In the comin weeks, you'll enjoy more clarity or movement with finances, personal possessions, work, and income, and you can suffer less from indecisiveness.

Mercury turns direct today after three weeks of retrograde motion, dear Scorpio, and Venus also ends its retrograde. While these shifts signal that communication problems will clear up, we can't expect it to happen in an instant. Instead, there can be a temporary magnification of problem areas right now. Fortunately, you are likely to be clearer as Mercury moves forward in your sign in the weeks ahead. Soon enough, Venus will return to your sign. Problems expressing yourself or feeling misunderstood can also clear up in the coming days. Today, take extra care when communicating and avoid focusing on the superficial elements of conversations, situations, and systems, which can lead to errors. For now, you’re still a little cautious with your heart. You’re not quite ready to make big decisions. In the weeks ahead, though, you’ll slowly but surely get back on track in the areas of love, pleasure, and comfort. Keep in mind that today’s shifts can be disorienting, and with the resulting ambiguity, it’s best to take things slowly.

After six weeks of retrograde motion, Venus turns direct today, dear Sagittarius, helping to clarify your social life. Mercury also ends its retrograde. You'll soon enjoy progress on certain fronts, particularly related to your friendships, partnerships, work, and health. Ideally, you’ve learned a lot about what and who you want in recent weeks, and going forward, you’ll be seeing some delays lift and projects or relationships move forward. You now enjoy a better understanding of what and who you like, as well as how you genuinely feel about your relationships and pastimes. People may be giving off confusing signals today, or you may experience some ups and downs or confusion and indecision as these shifts occur. You can put recent introspection and intuitive insight into action, although you're still inclined to keep to yourself and hold off on important decisions until Mercury enters Sagittarius on December 6th.

Mercury's three-week retrograde period comes to an end today, dear Capricorn, and Venus ends its six-week retrograde. It's unusual for this to happen on the same day! Communication can remain confusing as Mercury changes direction, and perhaps even more so before it begins to clear up. Although today may feel a little chaotic because you tend to overthink, these shifts in direction can improve relations with friends and associates, especially over the coming days and weeks. You'll dwell less on the past, and you'll start to take more interest in making the most of what you have now. Plans that might have recently stalled could resume or end--either way, they're no longer up in the air, and you can make a decision. Ideally, you’ve gained valuable insight into your working relationships, reputation, and the satisfaction you feel (or don’t feel) with work projects or long-term goals. Problems related to your reputation, relationships, and pleasure begin to clear or unclog. Delays lift, some questions are answered, and life goes on! It becomes more straightforward to enjoy yourself and the people you care about.

Unusually, both Mercury and Venus end their retrograde cycles today, dear Aquarius. As you advance, this is a fine time to connect with people who expand your perspective. You’ll gain clarity about your satisfaction with your life, connections, belief systems, and life path. In the coming weeks, you’re likely to enjoy delays lifting and increased pleasure associated with your relationships, travel, studies, reputation, and work. Home life may become more comfortable, or family relationships improve, possibly with a new, more mature understanding. People in your life may seem friendlier or more accessible. You can experience more clarity with long-term, career, or life-plan goals, as well as with your romantic life. Work projects or responsibilities can resume normal speed or pick up pace. For now, however, while the shifts occur, we can be unusually error-prone.

Mercury stations and turns direct after a three-week retrograde period, dear Pisces, and Venus also ends its retrograde period today. Venus has been retrograde since early October. Certainly, these shifts can magnify problem areas, but they signal unblocking and forward movement. It can also mean you're tuning in far too much to the details and facts of a situation, so much so that intuition takes a back seat and leaves you with fewer resources to make the right decisions. Wait things out, if possible. Over the coming weeks, more clarity is likely in many areas of your life, and you can experience renewed confidence in yourself and your plans, as well as faith that life will supply you with what you need. Ideally, you’ve reviewed your affections, arrangements, and obligations in recent weeks, and now you feel better equipped to make decisions. Although there may have been some confusion or stagnation in your love life, romantic expression and attention improve in the weeks ahead. You may discover new ways to enjoy yourself and revive an old interest or study. Connections may be made with siblings or classmates that bring you more joy. Publishing matters may unblock. If you can, avoid big decisions now and then ease yourself forward.
